Table 1: Temporal differentiation on 15 held-out donors, covering 30 prediction requests in the 2,009-gene evaluation space. Scores are aggregated across donors and requested times within each run. Entries report mean ± standard deviation over three randomized test runs with fixed trained models.

Figure 1: TempoBridge overview. (a) Temporal, genetic, and drug-response models use a common sourceconditioned transport formulation and are trained independently. (b) Source cells initialize latent particles and provide a fixed empirical population summary. The velocity field takes the evolving latent state, flow time, source summary, and encoded transition descriptor as inputs. Each task model has its own expression decoder. Minibatch OT constructs training paths; inference requires no target expression or OT computation.
